name: james-heinrich/getid3
input_api: (new getID3())->analyze(local temporary file path) -> ['mpeg']['audio'] frame-header fields, ['playtime_seconds'], ['avdataoffset'..'avdataend']
scope: MPEG audio frame header of an untagged stream (version, layer, sample rate, channels, channel mode, bitrate, frame length) with frame-sync validation, and CBR duration from audio-data bytes
family_note: Same getID3 code base as the mp3_id3v2/php james-heinrich/getid3 entry (and the getID3 wrappers there); this record covers the MPEG frame-header module, not module.tag.id3v2.php.

name: wapmorgan/mp3info
input_api: new wapmorgan\Mp3Info\Mp3Info(local temporary file path) -> codecVersion, layerVersion, sampleRate, channel, bitRate, isVbr, audioSize, _framesCount, duration
documentation_note: The README documents new Mp3Info($filename) and the codecVersion, layerVersion, audioSize, duration, bitRate, sampleRate, isVbr and channel properties; _framesCount is a public property documented only in the class source ('Number of audio frames in file').
release_evidence: Packagist p2 metadata lists 0.1.1 (2025-04-01, reference e532c2e1997874f9c672c7810ce90ef15004ef94) as the newest tagged release; checked 2026-11-17.
scope: First two MPEG audio frame headers of an untagged MPEG-1 Layer III CBR stream (version, layer, sample rate, channel mode, bitrate) with a frame-count estimate from audio bytes and computed frame length; duration is (frames - 1) x 1152 / sample rate
family: Mp3Info native PHP MPEG frame-header reader (src/Mp3Info.php)
family_note: Independent of getID3: the pinned package is one class (src/Mp3Info.php) with its own bitrate and sample-rate tables, no getID3 code or dependency, and a different frame-length and duration method. The same package is counted for ID3v2 scope in mp3_id3v2/php; wapmorgan/media-file wraps it.

controls/mp3/tone-44k-mono.mp3.duration_note: Mp3Info reports (11 - 1) x 1152 / 44100 = 0.26122 s; the oracle's 11 x 1152 samples are 0.28735 s. The one-frame difference is Mp3Info's documented formula, not a parsing error.

controls/mp3/tone-22k-stereo.mp3.mismatch: The first header is read correctly, but the next jump uses floor(144 x 32000 / 22050) = 208 bytes (MPEG-1 coefficient; the MPEG-2 frame is 104 or 105 bytes). The sync scan then steps two bytes at a time from 208, misses the real frame at 209, and accepts the bytes ffeda7ff at offset 236 inside audio data. The last-read false header becomes the result: MPEG-2 Layer II, 24 kHz mono, 96 kbit/s, 3 frames, 0.096 s.
